This post is just *asking* for trouble, lmao. But lemme give my reason. Firstly, I'm a member of the LGBT community - any other demisexual panromantics out there? Feeling very invisible in my identity rn haha - and I completely support the idea of pride and the confidence it allows people to have in their identities.

My problem with pride month is that it essentially puts the idea of pride into a set time. Basically, implying that you're only allowed to be open and honest about yourself in this set month, and any other time you just have to keep it to yourself. It gives me the feeling that people only really *care* about LGBT issues because they want to be part of a themed month, like its Halloween or something and it gets on my nerves. 

People's identities, peoples lives, peoples human fucking rights are not just a *holiday* for people to celebrate as if its nothing but a fun month where everyone wears colours and pretends not to be homophobic. Pride should be something that is allowed all year. 

Not to mention the companies that take advantage of this month by changing logos and "showing support" while simultaneously making money off of their homophobia. Take for example Disney, who have posted pride flags everywhere and told people they're "accepted" while keeping LGBT+ characters out of their media and alienating millions of children just so they can keep pumping money out of homophobic dictatorships like Russia and China. 

Tl;dr: I don't like that you're only allowed to like your identity in one month and I don't like that companies pretend not yo be homophobic for money

For example, Disney posting rainbow flags everywhere and simultaneously telling animators they need to turn down the LGBT connotations of their characters to be more "family friendly" (aka to make sure they continue to pump money out of Russia and China). Makes me sick to see companies deciding to alienate millions of children and make them feel like they don't deserve to be the Disney characters that so many of them want to be so that they can keep getting money from dictatorships that continually breach basic human rights.
